data.turoyo: Kul yawmo di ʕruto koməbli kačke w maxamlila mu dahwo, mu semo w kobile, koxela, kobelan saʕaye maye.
data.translation: Jeden Freitag bringen sie ein Mädchen hin, schmücken es mit Silber und Gold und geben es ihm. Dann frißt es das Mädchen und gibt uns eine Stunde Wasser.

rationale: Thin Infectum cell: m-marked adornment material in habitual context.

summary: The Kurdish-derived stem is consistently II. ruḥe/ruḥa/ruḥayye marks active self-adornment; it does not make the form Detransitive. Part. Pass. mxamle describes the resultant adorned state.

Animate patients can be suffixed, the cradle is a zero-marked nominal object, and m- introduces silver/gold as adornment material (112/309). Inanimate patients require a participant extension, not another numbered sense.
The roller episode at /43 explains the otherwise less transparent /42 by adding Joseph’s picture. The two verses are one narrative event, not independent new meanings.
Confirm segmentation of mxamlila at 66/351: Preterit with plural object versus 3pl Infectum with feminine object. The German causative/reflexive wording does not settle this.
Correct the language abbreviation Kurd= to Kurd.
rationale: The equals sign after the etymological language abbreviation is an evident punctuation slip. The entry uses the standard etymology construction < Kurd. followed by the Kurdish forms; this is not a Turoyo clitic boundary.
